footer.provenance: This portal displays information as recorded by the concerned authority. For the authoritative record, contact the office of the Collector.

search.heading: Check the status of your land
search.villageHint: Type at least 2 letters of the village name

notices.heading: Published notices
notices.hint: Copies are available at the office of the Collector. The fingerprint lets you check that a copy is unaltered.

objection.heading: File an objection
objection.intro: You can file an objection only while the objection window for the project is open.
objection.name: Your name
objection.filed: Your objection has been filed. Reference: {ref}
objection.closed: The objection window for this project is not open.

ack.heading: Confirm your payment
ack.question: Did you receive this amount?
ack.confirmOtp: Yes — confirm with a code sent by SMS
ack.done: Thank you. Your confirmation has been recorded.
ack.disputed: Your report has been sent to the office of the Collector.
ack.invalid: This link is not valid, has been used, or has expired.
ack.notPaid: This payment has not been completed yet — you can confirm it once it is paid.
ack.noPasskey: No fingerprint/face is registered on this phone for your family — use the SMS code.

enrol.heading: Register your phone
enrol.intro: Hello {name}. Register this phone's fingerprint or face unlock so you can confirm payments yourself. Your fingerprint never leaves your phone.
enrol.done: This phone is registered. You can now confirm payments with your fingerprint or face.
enrol.invalid: This registration link is not valid, has been used, or has expired.
enrol.unsupported: This phone or browser cannot do fingerprint/face registration. Please ask the officer about the SMS code option.

passbook.heading: R&R passbook
passbook.invalid: This passbook link is not valid or has expired.
